headline: Tapestry Stock Gains on Strong Quarterly Results and Raised Guidance
summary: Tapestry shares advanced following the release of strong quarterly financial results and an upward revision to its corporate guidance.
why: Earnings beats and upward guidance revisions signal robust operational execution and inspire increased investor confidence in a company's financial trajectory.

impacts.name: Tapestry Inc
impacts.why: Strong financial results and raised guidance drive positive investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected quarterly financial performance and an upward revision in forward guidance prompt increased buying interest in the company's shares.
